agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider cancelling 2025 tax sale of West 10th Avenue properties
agenda_briefs.summary: Vancouver Council will consider cancelling the 2025 tax sale of the leasehold interest at 1208–1575 West 10th Avenue (PID 024-230-251) because no notice of the sale was given to anyone with an interest in the property, which the City calls a manifest error. The City itself was the purchaser, so no private buyer is affected. The full amount owing at the November 12, 2025 sale was $169,271.06; the heir paid $156,393.90 the next day, leaving a shortfall plus further taxes now due. The cancellation must be declared by November 12, 2026, the end of the one-year redemption period.
agenda_briefs.action_required: If you hold an interest in the leasehold at 1208–1575 West 10th Avenue, contact the City about the outstanding tax balance before the November 12, 2026 redemption period ends.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider updating Vancouver apartment regulations
agenda_briefs.summary: Vancouver Council will consider By-law 5, which amends the Zoning and Development By-law to update apartment regulations, at its October 27, 2026 meeting. Several other bylaws — CD-1 rezoning amendments for sites including 2111 Main Street, Heather Lands (South), 2110 West 5th Avenue, 2158-2170 West 1st Avenue, 1613-1625 Nanaimo Street and 2202-2212 West 10th Avenue, plus a housing agreement at 461-479 East 16th Avenue — only take effect if By-law 5 passes. If By-law 5 fails, alternative versions of the Nanaimo Street and West 10th Avenue rezonings will be considered instead.

The agenda item does not spell out exactly what would change, so builders and developers should watch for the staff report and the final wording before relying on current levy calculations.

minutes_briefs.title: Council adopted updated apartment regulations policies, effective October 27, 2026
minutes_briefs.summary: Council voted unanimously to adopt changes to three housing policies tied to the City's "Updating Apartment Regulations" work: the Family Room: Housing Mix Policy for Rezoning Projects, the Secured Rental Policy, and the Below-Market Rental Housing Policy for Rezonings. These policy changes took effect on October 27, 2026, after the related Zoning and Development By-law amendments were passed.
